ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast; central ~65% of visible surface area is low-intensity (black/dark grey), distal ~35% (tips) is high-intensity (white).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and inferior regions are solid low-intensity. Distal lobes (left and right) are high-intensity. Right distal lobe contains four parallel vertical low-intensity rake bands. Left distal lobe contains one focal circular low-intensity spot and one diagonal linear mark.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression, approximately 55 degrees; depth is significant, extending approximately 15% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe exhibits high-amplitude serrations including a prominent rectangular notch (approx. 10% lobe width). Left lobe displays lower-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to distal tips that taper and curve upward relative to the horizon.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular low-intensity cluster (~5px diameter) on the left high-intensity distal lobe; smaller scattered low-intensity clusters at the extreme distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Four parallel, high-contrast vertical linear low-intensity marks on the right lobe; one singular diagonal linear abrasion on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Large, deep rectangular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; multiple smaller irregular notches on both lobe perimeters.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant bilateral asymmetry in trailing edge contour due to localized tissue loss on the right lobe.
